name: vox-annotate
description: The Vox-style annotate gesture: a keyword in a held sentence gets a hand-drawn marker while a thin connector draws up to a mono callout label, all as one choreographed beat on the cue.

vars.description: First case-insensitive substring match in text receives the marker and annotation. Empty or unmatched draws nothing.
Mono callout label at the end of the connector. Empty draws the marker only.
Shape of the hand-drawn marker stroke.
Second (from mount start) the annotate gesture starts. Clamped so the gesture completes before any exit.
Annotation ink color from the contract token map.
Optional departure. Default none: the lockup holds until the frame cuts.
